lines.text: Afraid dogs or afraid of dogs?
Many learners say: I am afraid dogs.
Better: I am afraid of dogs.
Of! She is afraid of spiders.

native.tip: Бояться — “afraid of”: “I am afraid of dogs.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I am afraid dogs”? 😅 По-русски «я боюсь собак» — без предлога, поэтому его легко пропустить, но по-английски нужно “of.” Правильно: “I am afraid of dogs.” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.

en.hook: Afraid dogs or afraid of dogs?
en.tip: To fear something, use “afraid of”: “I am afraid of dogs.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I am afraid dogs”? 😅 In Russian there is no small word here, so it is easy to miss, but English needs “of.” Correct: “I am afraid of dogs.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
